rating_definitions.substantial: Independent corroboration and primary/specialist page-level evidence, precise geography and visitor/rights verification
rating_definitions.developing: Specific source locator supports a meaningful explanation, but primary triangulation or field verification remains open
rating_definitions.sparse: Only abstract, approximate place or uninspected core data; not yet a complete explanation
rating_definitions.missing: Core location, object provenance, photographic rights or evidence needed for interpretation remains missing
